arStrings.szText: While in {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, your {c_important}Demonology{/c} Skill damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|1x%|]{/c} for every point of {c_important}Dominance{/c} you currently have. While not in {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, your {c_important}Summon{/c} Skills deal {c_number}[{SF_4}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and you gain {c_number}[{SF_2}|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Dominance every second.
